<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups in the unknown molecule. The available tools can provide NMR spectra for the sample. By retrieving the 13C NMR spectrum, we can identify carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). Counting distinct methyl carbon signals will give the number of methyl groups. We'll start by obtaining the 13C NMR spectrum.</thought>
